method: 4-connectivity flood fill on the RGBA alpha channel of each *_static_v1.png (1 frame, no anti-aliasing / no partial-alpha pixels in any of the three icons). connected_components = number of disjoint opaque blobs. enclosed_holes = number of transparent regions that do NOT touch the 32x32 canvas border (i.e. fully surrounded by opaque pixels) -- a topological hole in the silhouette.

telegraph_alert_static_v1.png.shape: 1 vertical bar (exclamation stem) + 1 small rounded dot, disjoint

telegraph_melee_static_v1.png.shape: 1 inverted (point-down) triangle + 1 upright (point-up) triangle, disjoint, facing tips across a narrow gap -- category-different from alert's bar+dot even though component count matches

telegraph_summon_static_v1.png.shape: 1 six-point ring/star blob with a fully enclosed transparent hole in the center -- the only one of the three icons with a hole, and the only one with a single connected component

conclusion: All three icons differ in silhouette topology and/or basic shape category (rectangle+circle vs opposing triangles vs holed ring), independent of color. Verified by direct flood-fill computation, not visual judgement alone.
